business_problem: China Mobile Online needed faster and deeper customer-intent insight than manual sampling and call listening could provide so it could support precision marketing, real-time service intervention, and low-threshold model reuse across business teams.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud built a real-time intelligent-insight platform for China Mobile Online to analyze service interactions at scale and turn those signals into operational actions. The platform consolidates underlying modeling and analytics capabilities so business teams can create, manage, and iterate insight models without rebuilding data labeling and algorithm components every time. Customer, agent, and scenario data are transformed into intelligent profiles that support intent prediction, complaint handling, script mining, and priority routing across online marketing and service flows. On top of this shared base, the system provides self-service modeling, centralized model management, and real-time knowledge-push functions that surface scripts to agents during calls. The architecture shifts China Mobile Online away from delayed sample analysis toward minute-level warnings, faster clustering, and reusable model services that can be applied across at least ten core production scenarios.
products_used: Self-service Modeling and Model Management Tools

solution_components.name: Real-time Intelligent Insight Platform
solution_components.role: Serves as the shared analytics and inference backbone for customer-intent prediction and operational insight.

solution_components.name: Customer-Agent-Business Profiling Engine
solution_components.role: Builds intelligent portraits for customers, seats, and business scenarios to support personalized service and interventions.

solution_components.name: Self-service Modeling and Model Management Tools
solution_components.role: Let business teams create, reuse, and operate insight models through low-threshold centralized tooling.

solution_components.name: Real-time Knowledge Push Engine
solution_components.role: Pushes scripts and knowledge cues to agents during calls when specific service intents are detected.

data_flow: Call and online-interaction data is processed into customer, agent, and scenario profiles on the shared insight platform. Models predict intent, complaints, and routing needs in real time, and the resulting insights are sent into script-push, priority-transfer, clustering, and warning workflows that support marketing and customer-service operations.
business_outcome: China Mobile Online gained faster response to operational signals, better customer-intent capture, higher script coverage, and a reusable model-management foundation that improves both service operations and targeted marketing.
metrics: Core models achieve more than 80% accuracy.
Response speed to intelligent-analysis requests improves 50%.
Script and knowledge push coverage exceeds 85%.
Clustering analysis timeliness is reduced to less than 1 hour from about 3 hours.
Burst-event alerts are triggered at minute level instead of roughly once per hour.
The platform supports at least 10 core production scenarios.
architecture_clues: The platform is designed to reuse data labeling, operators, and model services across multiple business teams.
Intelligent profiles are built for customers, seats, and business scenarios rather than a single hotline use case.
Real-time script push is one of the primary production outputs of the insight platform.
